input.brief: COMPaSS is a civic operations mapping and patrol support system for the PNP station in Oroquieta City, built by LUMENEERS at USTP Oroquieta

direction.name: One motif
direction.idea: Take one shape from the subject and let it run the whole system. A drilling tool's octagonal cross-section becomes the buttons, the image masks and the loader. A two-account money app becomes two circles that recur as icon, inline dot and section colour. A café's striped awning becomes every band on the page. Look at the product, the logo, the object or the word in the headline and find the simplest geometry in it (a circle, an arc, a chamfer, a stripe, a notch, a ring). Then use only that shape, at three or four very different scales, everywhere a designer would normally reach for a generic rounded rectangle.
direction.composition: Hero: the motif appears once at enormous scale as a flat filled shape, cropped by the viewport (a circle 120vh across entering from the right, a chamfered block filling the lower half), with a short headline at 6–8vw and one supporting sentence set on the remaining ground, left-aligned on a shared margin. Through the page the motif returns as: the mask for every photograph (via `clip-path` or `border-radius` made from the same geometry), the shape of the primary button, the bullet beside list items at text size, and one full-width band that separates the two halves of the page. Sections use simple two-column or single-column layouts so the shape is the only thing with character.
direction.typography: A clean geometric or grotesk face that echoes the shape (round bowls for circles, squared terminals for chamfers). Medium weight; headings 6–8vw in the hero and 3–4vw after.
direction.colour: The motif carries the accent colour at large scale, flat. Everything else is ground and ink. A second motif colour is allowed only if the subject has a real pair (two accounts, two modes).
direction.imagery: Photographs appear inside the motif's shape. If there is product interface to show, it sits on a flat colour stage shaped by the motif. Draw the shape with CSS or a simple inline SVG path; do not draw illustrations.
direction.richness: One shape at many sizes. The giant cropped shape gives the hero mass and colour without a single image.
direction.pitfalls: One motif means one. A circle here, a hexagon there and a blob behind is the generated look this replaces. The motif must come from the subject and you must be able to say from where in one clause.

hero.name: Fragment on a shaped stage
hero.blueprint: A neutral ground. The headline occupies the upper-left third: two lines at clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px), medium weight, flush left on columns 1–6 at a 40px margin, starting 150px down. One supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, follows, then the single action as a small rectangular button. The rest of the screen belongs to one flat stage in a saturated colour: it spans columns 5–12, begins 42% down, and bleeds off the right and bottom edges. Its top-left corner is cut with the product's own shape using `clip-path` (a notch, a chamfer or a tab two columns wide), the only decoration on the page. On the stage, 56px in from its left and top edges, sits the main fragment of the interface at true size with labels at 13–15px, built in HTML and working: one panel or control about 620px wide, cropped by the bottom edge, never a whole window and never inside a browser or laptop frame. Mark its root with data-ui. Navigation is a plain row at 28px from the top: wordmark left and four text links right at 15px. Nothing overlaps the headline.
hero.mobile: The headline sits under the wordmark at 10vw on two lines, followed by the sentence at 16px and the button. The stage comes next at full width, bleeding off both sides and the bottom, its corner cut kept at 72px wide. The fragment sits 16px inside it at true size; if it is wider than the screen the right edge crops it rather than scaling it down.
hero.headline: A plain statement of what the product does in three to six words, two lines of up to about 16 characters each at 5.2vw.

photos.title: Architecture
photos.note: structure, lines, bridges, facades and building interiors

photos.alt: Dark station platform with a row of bright windows, black and white
Grand station concourse with arched windows and a blurred crowd
White apartment block facade with repeating balconies and windows

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Statement with inline thumbnails
sections.blueprint: A centred statement of 18–28 words, four lines at clamp(32px, 4.2vw, 62px), medium or bold weight, leading 1.12, in a block 60–66% of the viewport wide with 22vh of empty ground above and below. Three to five small frames sit inline between words: each is an `inline-block` 0.85em tall and 0.85–1.3em wide, `vertical-align: -0.1em`, radius 0.14em, holding a tightly cropped photograph (or a crop of real interface) of the thing the neighbouring word names. Frames are part of the line, never floating over it, with 0.12em of space either side. No heading above and no paragraph below; the statement is set as a `p`. Directly under the section the page may split into two flat colour halves or begin the first product row, so the thumbnails read as a preview of what follows. On a motif-driven page every frame takes the motif's shape.
sections.mobile: Left-aligned instead of centred, at 8vw with leading 1.15, about seven lines inside 20px margins. Keep at most three inline frames, each exactly one cap-height tall, and make sure none lands at the start of a line. Vertical padding drops to 96px.

sections.name: One control, blown up
sections.blueprint: A flat saturated field, full-bleed and 92svh tall, holds one working control from the product: the toggle, slider, segmented switch or record button the whole product turns on. Build it at true proportions with every dimension in em, mark its root data-ui, then raise that root's font-size until the control stands about 46vh tall. Anchor it right of centre so the section's right and bottom edges crop about a fifth of it (overflow: hidden on the section). It keeps its real label and value, now at poster size, and it works: operating it swaps the field between two palette colours and changes one word of the heading. The heading, two to four words at clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 40px), sits top-left on the page margin with one sentence at 17px beneath it. The lower-left third of the field stays empty.
sections.mobile: The field is 86svh. Heading and sentence sit top-left at 26px and 16px. The control is enlarged to about 130vw wide and anchored bottom-left, so the right edge crops its far end while its thumb or active segment stays within reach. It still works and still swaps the field colour.

sections.name: One card, four fields
sections.blueprint: Four flat colour fields stand side by side across the full viewport, each 25vw wide and 84svh tall, butted together with no gaps; neighbours differ clearly in lightness. The same card from the product (a ticket, an order, a request) appears once in each field at the same height, 38% down, centred, 260px wide at true size, each copy marked data-ui. It is further along every time: bare as it arrives, then with an owner and a due date, then with its checklist half ticked, then closed with its final figure. Along the bottom of each field, 28px in, one clause at clamp(22px, 2vw, 32px) on two lines begins with its order word: 'First it lands here.' 'Then someone takes it.' The heading, two to four words at the same size in the heaviest weight, sits top-left in the first field only. On hover a field's card rises 6px over 150ms.
sections.mobile: The fields stack, each full width and 64svh tall, colours meeting edge to edge. In each: the clause at 24px top-left with 20px margins, then the card at true size, left-aligned, 32px below. The heading sits in the first field above its clause, at 24px in the heaviest weight.

sections.name: Sentences with switches
sections.blueprint: Four or five capabilities, each one plain sentence of five to eight words about what the product will do for you, each ending in a working switch. Every sentence is a full-bleed band 20vh tall, butted against the next with no gap. Inside, on the 12-column grid: the sentence at clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 60px) on one line in columns 1–10, vertically centred; in columns 11–12, right-aligned, the product's real toggle, built in em with its root marked data-ui, 1.1em tall so it matches the type. Off, a band is the page ground and its sentence is in the soft ink. On, the band fills with a palette colour, a different one per band, the sentence turns to full ink and a second line at 17px appears beneath stating the consequence in figures. Two bands are on at load. Toggles answer click, Space and Enter. There is no heading; the first sentence does that work.
sections.mobile: Bands are at least 132px tall. The sentence is set at 6.4vw on two lines in the left 76% of the width; the toggle sits at the right, vertically centred, with a 44px touch target. When a band is on, the consequence line opens under the sentence at 15px.

sections.name: Inset panel, shaped portrait
sections.blueprint: A deep-toned panel inset 20px from the page edges with a 12px radius, about 110svh tall, `overflow: hidden`. Left half: a two-line statement of four to seven words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px) in a pale ink, top-left with 56px padding; it is the heading and has nothing above it. Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.
sections.mobile: The panel is inset 10px and stacks: the statement at 8.5vw, then the two text blocks at full width, the button, and last the shaped photograph at 86vw across, centred and cropped by the panel's bottom edge by a quarter of its height.

sections.name: One word is the button
sections.blueprint: The entire band is one link. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, about 60svh tall, contains a single verb of four to eight letters set at 24–30vw in the heaviest weight, tight tracking, sized with `clamp()` so it spans the content width on one line with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The `<a>` wraps the whole band; on hover and focus the field and the word swap colours instantly. In the top-left corner, at 20px, one sentence says what happens next; in the top-right, an arrow drawn as a simple inline SVG, 48px, points up and right. There is no other button anywhere in the section. In a page with a motif, the band's top corners take the motif's shape (a large radius, or a chamfer cut with `clip-path`). Keep the word honest: the action itself, not a slogan.
sections.mobile: The band is 46svh tall. The word is set at whatever size fills the width on one line; choose a shorter verb rather than going below 22vw. Sentence top-left at 17px across two lines, arrow top-right at 32px. The whole band stays tappable.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: SSTR - Friction Reduction
references.idea: Drilling hardware treated like precision consumer tech: a chamfered octagon taken from the tool's cross-section drives the buttons, icons and loader.
references.hero: The captured first viewport is the preloader: a 2 by 2 grid with hairline dividers, top-left quadrant solid orange with the slash-prefixed name at 5.6vw in black bold grotesk; top-right dark with a plus-sign dot grid and an orange square beside a percentage; bottom quadrants hold wireframe octagon stacks under small labels. The real hero is a full-bleed grey 3D render of a steel downhole tool rising from bottom centre. A two-line uppercase headline at about 3.5vw in light grotesk sits left-anchored at mid-height, with a short paragraph and an orange chamfered-corner button below. A slim bar holds logo left, five small caps links, globe and contact right.
references.type: ABC Monument Grotesk: bold for the loader mark, but headlines are regular or light uppercase with tight tracking at roughly 36 to 50px over 14px body. Uppercase labels at 10 to 11px carry a square orange bullet. Statistic numerals jump to about 6.7vw in a thin weight.
references.colour: #18191b #eff0f1 #ff5a2a #2f3032 #c3c4c8 — Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate; one safety orange marks buttons, bullets, the loader block and the highlighted chart series. Renders are desaturated steel so orange never competes.
references.imagery: Desaturated 3D renders of drilling tools, full-bleed in the hero and as a long drill string bending along a well path; thin wireframe octagon line drawings as service icons; a chart drawn in dots.
references.layout: Content sits inside vertical hairline rails about 35px in from each edge, with sections subdivided into two or three bordered cells. Dark and light sections alternate. Text blocks are left-aligned and narrow; a pinned well-path sequence breaks the grid with a full-bleed scene.

sections.description: Light grey section inside vertical hairline rails. An uppercase two-line heading at about 2.4vw sits top-left with an orange chamfered button under it. Below, three equal columns divided by hairlines, each about 230px tall: a wireframe line drawing of stacked octagons in the upper half, then an uppercase title at 13px and three lines of small grey body. No fills, no icon circles, no shadows.

Graphite section split into two bordered cells. Left cell, vertically centred: a tiny bracketed before-and-after range in caps, a statistic at about 6.7vw in thin grotesk, a one-word label and an orange chamfered button. Right cell: a line chart drawn entirely in dots, white for the baseline and orange for the improved run, with faint axis labels and a two-item legend using short colour bars.

Pinned full-viewport dark scene. A 3D drill string enters at top-left, runs down, bends through ninety degrees and continues along the bottom to the right edge, with bright tool segments spaced along it. A text block right of centre holds a small orange-bulleted label, a four-line uppercase statement at about 2vw and two lines of body. Bottom edge: a back-to-start link left, a chevron scroll cue centre, a skip link right.

steal: Derive one shape from the product (here a chamfered octagon) and reuse it for button corners, icons and loader graphics.
Draw charts with dots rather than lines and reserve the accent colour for the one data series you want read.
Turn the preloader into a branded four-cell grid that previews the site's colour blocks and wireframe icons.
references.media: A full-bleed 13s monochrome loop of a drilling tool descending over grey sand covers the whole fold with the text straight on it at the left, oversized for parallax. Below: a full-bleed WebGL chapter with the caption right of centre and a depth gauge at the edge, line-drawn icons in three equal cells, dot-plot charts beside big figures zigzagging per row, a 4:1 product strip under a giant product-code heading, and 3:2 case photographs in a right-hand column; 33 images and 3 videos, 0px radius.
references.motion: On desktop the video plays from 400ms while every text line shows as a solid orange bar the size of the line, like redaction, and the type replaces the bars by 1.2s. Under Lenis the hero video parallaxes at scrub 2, heads rise as masked lines over 0.6-0.82s expo.out at a 0.04-0.06 stagger, chart dots switch on one by one (1004 rects at 0.15s), stats roll digit columns, the WebGL chapter is step-locked with skip controls, and buttons fill with a clip-path sweep over 0.375s; there are 10 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: Tara
references.idea: Two pastel circles, mint for saving and pink for spending, stand for the app's two accounts and recur as icon, inline dot, section colour and card gradient.
references.hero: Off-white field with no navigation, only a small bold wordmark top-left. The left column is vertically centred and starts about 8% in: a two-line headline in a wide heavy grotesk at roughly 6vw with tight leading, a grey one-line subhead beneath, then a pill-shaped email field about 400px wide with a black pill button nested inside its right end. The right half holds a 3D pair floating on the page colour: a mint-to-pink gradient bank card tilted about 30 degrees, overlapping a perspective-tilted phone showing a balance screen. Two small award badges are stacked on the right edge. Roughly half the viewport is empty.
references.type: Herokid Wide at weight 600 with -0.04em tracking for headlines, regular-width Herokid for everything else. Sentence case in the hero, all-caps for the scroll statements. Roughly 86px headline against 14px body, with a mid size of about 24px for centred explainer lines.
references.colour: #f8f8f8 #0a0a0a #c3edce #f8c7c9 #ffffff — Near-white base with black type. Mint and pink appear only as the two account colours: first as small circles, then as full-screen section fields and a soft glow behind the footer wordmark.
references.imagery: 3D bank card and tilted phone mock-ups carrying app screens, floating without a container on the page colour; later a straight-on phone on a flat mint field. Simple line icons inside solid pastel circles.
references.layout: Twenty screens of scroll but very little per screen: one centred object or statement per viewport with large empty margins. A wordmark top-left and a tiny pill button top-right persist. Full-bleed pastel fields mark the two product chapters; a row of four white cards closes.

sections.description: A pinned, nearly empty viewport where a single mint circle holding a line icon sits upper-centre with a pink circle peeking from behind it. On scroll the pink circle slides out to sit beside the mint one, overlapping slightly, each with its own icon, and three centred lines of roughly 24px text appear beneath explaining the two accounts. Nothing else is on screen.

A chapter-title screen: two words of heavy uppercase at about 5vw, centred and stacked on two lines, with a mint dot the height of the capitals sitting inline after the first word like punctuation. The dot is the same circle from the previous scene, so the colour carries its meaning straight into the full-mint section that follows.

Full-viewport mint field. A small eyebrow and a bold product name are centred near the top. Below, a straight-on phone mock-up stands just right of centre, and a short right-aligned bold claim with two lines of small text sits to its left, level with the phone's lower third. Text and phone hug the centre line, leaving both outer thirds empty.

After four white rounded cards and a repeated centred email pill, the footer is one row of small links and then the wordmark set enormous, around 45vw wide and cropped by the bottom edge. It is white on the off-white page and becomes visible only through blurred pink and mint glows placed behind the letters.

steal: Assign each product concept a colour and a shape early (two pastel circles), then reuse it as bullet, inline punctuation dot and full section background.
Nest the call-to-action button inside the email field's pill so the form reads as one object.
Set the footer wordmark in the page's own background colour and reveal it only with soft coloured glows behind the letters.

references.name: Alethia
references.idea: Nature as measured data: photoreal moss-covered rocks and terrain float in a dark field, annotated with instrument-style reticles and mono readouts.
references.hero: Dark forest-green field. A photoreal 3D boulder covered in moss and small plants floats at centre, about 45% of the viewport wide, with three smaller rocks drifting at lower left, upper right and lower right, the last cropped by the edge. A three-line white headline at about 5vw, medium weight with tight tracking, is flush to a 30px left margin near the top and overlaps the rock's left side. Under it, an outlined button in mono caps with a lime arrow square. A hairline square reticle sits on the rock with a small mono data tag and three lines of readout. Bottom-left: a three-line 24px statement. Bottom-right: a scroll hint.
references.type: Geist Medium for headlines at about 70px with -0.05em tracking; Geist Regular at 24 to 40px for statements, also tight; Geist Mono in bold uppercase for navigation, buttons, tags, bracketed card labels and data readouts at 10 to 14px. The footer wordmark is drawn about 330px tall.
references.colour: #0f1f10 #ffffff #000000 #c6f19d #6d8b3a #9a9d9a — Forest green, black and white sections with a pale lime accent on arrow squares, tags, hotspots and the footer wordmark. Renders stay in moss greens and stone browns under grey fog.
references.imagery: Photoreal CG of mossy rocks, seedlings, soil and a weather-station mast, shown floating on flat colour or as full-bleed foggy macro landscapes; two nature photographs in rounded cards. Hairline reticles, lime hotspots and mono captions are laid over them.
references.layout: 30px margins, with text habitually docked in the corners of full-viewport scenes: headline top-left, statement bottom-left or top-right. Full-bleed 3D scenes alternate with a white card section and a black centred statement; the page ends on a full-width wordmark.

sections.description: A full-bleed macro landscape of moss mounds, bare soil and one seedling under grey fog. A five-line statement at about 40px occupies the top-right, from 35% to 84% of the width, with a three-line mono micro-label at the far top-left. Four lime circular markers with a dotted glyph are pinned across the terrain, each followed by a three-line mono caption in white.

A full-bleed foggy render of a weather-station mast among rocks and shrubs. Upper left, a three-line heading preceded by a small diagonal arrow. At left, a frosted-glass rounded card about 310px wide holds a small line chart under a large figure. Right of the mast, a stack of five translucent rows about 420px wide, each a mono index number, an uppercase mono label and a plus sign, works as an accordion over the image.

White section. A lime rectangular mono tag sits above a two-line heading at about 53px, both flush left with the right half empty. Below, two image cards share the full width with a 20px gap and roughly 19px radius: a dewy leaf macro and an aerial of terraced fields. Each carries a bracketed mono label top-left, a lime circular arrow button top-right and a two-line white title over the image at bottom-left.

A blurred dark foliage photograph as background. The wordmark in pale lime spans the full width, letters about 330px tall and touching both margins. Then a hairline, office cities in lime at about 36px on the left and four columns of mono uppercase links on the right; a thin legal row with a back-to-top link at the very bottom.

steal: Overlay hairline reticles and mono data tags on an organic 3D object so that measurement becomes the visual subject.
Dock text in the corners of a full-viewport scene (headline top-left, statement bottom-left, hint bottom-right) and let the object own the centre.
Confine one pale accent colour to small squares and tags, then spend it once at full scale on a footer wordmark.
references.media: Cut-out specimen objects float on a flat green ground in the hero, about 35-40% of the area. Then oversized fixed footage scenes (150-160% of the viewport, so slow movement never shows an edge) crossfade under scroll for about 1.5 viewports with hotspots and cards over them before a white sheet rises over the pinned scene, and later come two-up rounded photo cards, product renders on black alternating sides and a scattered collage of small tiles round a centred heading, from 33 images and five muted ambient loops of 7-15s.
references.motion: A hexagon preloader is still up at 4.5s with scrolling locked, then fades over 600ms; the rock fades up from black and the headline rises 50px while fading in over 600ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.33,1) after a 2.2s delay. Lenis with Framer scroll effects holds a pinned opening for about 1352px; blocks reveal whole with a fade and a 50px rise, with no split text and no reduced-motion rule.
